# Marco Pröfrock

> Marco Pröfrock — creative, self employed, Stuttgart. Archive of award-winning work recognised by ADC, TDC, ICAD and Cannes Lions.

i studied product design and got a little carried away. now there are campaigns, identities, headlines and a typeface made from mineral water. there’s a perfectly reasonable explanation for all of this. several, actually. i’ve put them in the archive.

Contact: hello@marco.ad · +49 1590 8323432 · instagram marco.proe · linkedin marco-pröfrock

- [vote2cop](https://marco.ad/archive/vote2cop/): brand activation, gotv | nike, 2026. young adults camp from 3 a.m. for sneakers. they don't show up to vote.
- [the right way to say thank you](https://marco.ad/archive/thank-you/): ooh / print series, gotv, 2026. the „i voted" sticker is the most ordinary symbol of election day: familiar, expected and often forgotten within hours. „the right way to say thank you" gives this everyday piece of voting culture a …
- [500l/s](https://marco.ad/archive/500ls/): design system, academic work, 2026. stuttgart sits on europe's second-largest mineral water deposit – yet 75% of young residents don't know it exists. the springs hide in backyards, the baths look like ordinary public pools, and no …

- [hope in action](https://marco.ad/archive/hope-in-action/): integrated campaign, unicef, 2024. unicef is losing connection with gen z. 75% find the future frightening, 55.7% believe humanity is doomed. in this climate, hope feels naive – and unicef's mission becomes invisible to the generation …

- [windkulturerbe](https://marco.ad/archive/windkulturerbe/): brand activation, enbw, 2025. enbw is one of germany's largest energy companies – but virtually unknown outside baden-württemberg. at the same time, wind power faces constant public resistance, despite being one of the oldest …
- [u-turn](https://marco.ad/archive/u-turn/): design system, academic work, 2025. car vs. public transport is one of the most polarizing debates in urban mobility – yet most arguments stay abstract. people know the statistics but rarely feel the trade-offs of either choice in a …
